title: Nishi–Rosen Agreement
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Nishi–Rosen Agreement", at revision 1219043670, opens: "Nishi-Rosen Agreement  was an agreement signed between the Empire of Japan and the Russian Empire on 25 April 1898 concerning disputes over Korea." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1575941, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "agreement signed between the Empire of Japan and the Empire of Russia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
